## Files matching `test/shared/**`

### test/shared module scope

**`test/shared` is for code shared between multiple repositories.**

* Do not add code that is used by only a single repository.
* Do refactor code into `test/shared` instead of copying code to another repository.

**`test/shared` is for code that is generally useful across OpenShift OTE tests.**

**`test/shared` has a deliberately restricted set of dependencies.** Dependencies should be limited to Go modules that almost any OpenShift OTE test would already have, e.g.:

* `k8s.io` modules
* ginkgo
* `openshift/api`

If code requires a domain-specific dependency — e.g. a cluster-api provider or some specific vendor's SDK — that code is probably not suitable for `test/shared`.

The dependency boundary is enforced by the `depguard` linter (`list-mode: strict`) in `test/shared/.golangci.yml`. Adding an allowed dependency requires updating that allowlist, then running `go mod tidy && go mod vendor` in `test/shared` (verified in CI by `make verify`).
